Write a commented template of the configuration file, created with mode 0600.

Part of [`seek config`](seek-config.md).

## Usage

```text
seek config init [options]
```

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--server` | Use the server configuration |  |
| `--force` | Replace an existing file |  |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Configuration options

These flags set the configuration this command reads; the [configuration reference](../configuration.md) describes each setting.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--config <path>` | Read this configuration file in place of the default files (env: SEEK_CONFIG) |

## Exit statuses

`seek config init` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).

## Help

The output of `seek config init --help`:

```text
Usage: seek config init [options]

Write a commented template of the configuration file, created with mode 0600.

Options:
  --server    Use the server configuration
  --force     Replace an existing file
  -h, --help  display help for command

Configuration options:
  --config <path>
      Read this configuration file in place of the default files (env:
      SEEK_CONFIG)
```
